lines.text: On Preparation Day, in the evening, Joseph of Arimathea boldly went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus.
Pilate was surprised Jesus was already dead, so he summoned the high priest, and then he granted the body to Joseph.
Joseph wrapped the body in linen, placed it in a tomb cut out of the rock, and rolled a stone against the entrance.
After the Sabbath, the women bought spices and went to the tomb at sunrise, and they found the stone rolled away.
A young man in a white robe told the women that Jesus is going ahead of the disciples into Bethany.
